title: Risk Management Framework
description: A schema for representing the Risk Management Framework concepts.

AuthorizationBoundaryType.description: A unique type for authorization boundaries to determine the appropriate Authorizing Official.

id.description: Unique identifier for this authorization boundary type.

name.description: Name of the authorization boundary type (e.g., 'residential', 'commercial', 'historical').

description.description: Optional description of the authorization boundary type.

AuthorizationBoundary.description: A unique authorization boundary to determine the appropriate Authorizing Official.

id.description: Unique identifier for this authorization boundary.

acronym.description: Acronym or abbreviation for the authorization boundary (e.g., 'RES' for residential).

items.description: Reference to a child authorization boundary.

description.description: Optional description of the authorization boundary.

systems.description: List of top-level systems that are contained within this authorization boundary and that would explicitly be articulated in any Cyber Authorization.

items.$comment: References: SystemArchitecture.json - system, hardware, or software

CyberAuthorizationType.description: A unique type for cyber authorization such as ATO, IATT, etc.

id.description: Unique identifier for this cyber authorization type.

name.description: Name of the cyber authorization type (e.g., 'ATO', 'IATT').

acronym.description: Acronym or abbreviation for the cyber authorization type (e.g., 'ATO' for Authorized To Operate).

description.description: Optional description of the cyber authorization type.

CyberAuthorization.description: Represents a cyber authorization for a system.

id.description: Unique identifier for this cyber authorization.

duration.description: The duration of the authorization (e.g., '3 years', '6 months').

approvalDate.description: The date the authorization was approved (YYYY-MM-DD).

effectiveDate.description: The date the authorization becomes effective (YYYY-MM-DD).

authorizingOfficial.description: Reference to the person who is the Authorizing Official who accepts the risk and responsibility for the systems in the boundary.

owningProgramOffice.description: Reference to the organization that is the owning and responsible program office for the boundary.

ConfidentialityLevel.description: Collection of Confidentiality Levels which is defined as preserving authorized restrictions on information access and disclosure; including means for protecting privacy and proprietary information.

id.description: Unique identifier for this confidentiality level.

acronym.description: Acronym or abbreviation for the confidentiality level (e.g., 'L' for Low).

numericValue.description: Numeric value of the confidentiality level (e.g., 1 for Low, 2 for Moderate, 3 for High).

description.description: Optional description of the confidentiality level.

IntegrityLevel.description: Collection of Integrity Levels which is defined as guarding against improper information modification or destruction; including ensuring information non-repudiation and authenticity.

id.description: Unique identifier for this integrity level.

acronym.description: Acronym or abbreviation for the integrity level (e.g., 'L' for Low).

numericValue.description: Numeric value of the integrity level (e.g., 1 for Low, 2 for Moderate, 3 for High).

description.description: Optional description of the integrity level.

AvailabilityLevel.description: Collection of Availability Levels which is defined as ensuring timely and reliable access to and use of information.

id.description: Unique identifier for this availability level.

acronym.description: Acronym or abbreviation for the availability level (e.g., 'L' for Low).

numericValue.description: Numeric value of the availability level (e.g., 1 for Low, 2 for Moderate, 3 for High).

description.description: Optional description of the availability level.

PrivacyType.description: Collection of Privacy Types which define the sensitivity and handling requirements for personal information such as PII, PHI, etc.

id.description: Unique identifier for this privacy type.

name.description: Name of the privacy type (e.g., Name, Birth Date, SSN, etc).

acronym.description: Acronym or abbreviation for the privacy type.

description.description: Detailed description of the privacy type and its implications.

confidentialityLevel.description: Reference to the confidentiality level for the privacy type.

EntryPoint.description: Represents an entry point into a system within an authorization boundary.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entry point.

systemConnection.description: Reference to the system connection this entry point represents.

text.description: Descriptive text about the entry point.

authorizationBoundary.description: Reference to the authorization boundary this entry point belongs to.

entryPoints.description: Collection of entry points into systems within authorization boundaries.
